instruction: Tulis toggle mod gelap Tailwind dengan JS
output:
<button id="tema" aria-label="Tukar tema" class="rounded-lg border p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-800">🌙</button>
<script>
const b = document.getElementById('tema');
const gelap = () => document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark');
if (localStorage.tema === 'gelap') gelap();
b.onclick = () => {
  gelap();
  localStorage.tema = document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'gelap' : 'cerah';
};
</script>
Strategi `class` (bukan media): toggle `.dark` + simpan localStorage + baca semasa muat (elak kelip). Semua warna ada pasangan `dark:`.
